Saves the position and size of several widgets at once, as dragging and resizing on the dashboard does. Each breakpoint (xs, sm, md, lg) lists placements in grid units: i is the widget id, x and w count columns (12 on lg, 8 on md, 4 on sm, 2 on xs, and x + w must fit), and y and h count rows of 54 px with 12 px gaps. A widget named in any breakpoint has its whole stored layout replaced by the placements sent for it, so send all four breakpoints for every widget you move; a breakpoint it is missing from loses its stored position and is placed automatically. Layouts are per dashboard view because a widget belongs to one view. expectedVersions must name the version you last read for every widget in layouts; when a widget changed, was deleted or is not yours, nothing is saved and the request fails with 409 widgetLayoutChanged, so read again and retry. A large-breakpoint (lg) placement that overlaps another widget of the same dashboard view fails with 400 widgetLayoutOverlap; empty rows between widgets are allowed, and the dashboard moves widgets up into them, and one smaller than its widget minimum (2 rows for charts and numbers, 2 columns and 6 rows for activity timelines) fails with 400 widgetLayoutTooSmall. Unchanged placements are omitted from the result. Read positions and versions with /v1/widgets/list first.

Requires: ownership of the widgets; the list holds only the caller's own widgets and their results stay filtered by read access to the widgets' lists.
